ideas.pitch: A rapid-response web analysis extension and dashboard built for cyber-escape investigations involving hidden DOM elements, base64 ciphers, and manipulated cricket analytics payloads.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams participate in a multi-stage cyber-investigation challenge involving HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ciphers, cricket datasets, web analysis, and logical problem-solving.
ideas.title: CipherGuard IPL Web Exploit Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the skills tested in Round 1 of the Cyber-Escape challenge by automating cipher extraction and DOM inspection.

ideas.pitch: A live-auction decision support tool for the ₹80 Crores virtual purse that tracks player valuation curves, squad balance constraints, and competitor bidding velocity.
ideas.problem_statement: Qualified teams enter a simulated IPL Mega Auction environment with a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores and must construct their roster while complying with specified squad constraints.
ideas.title: AuctionPulse AI: Real-Time Bidding Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time data analysis to solve complex resource-allocation and constraint-satisfaction problems under intense time pressure during Round 2.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local cryptographic ledger to securely lock and verify player purchases made during the high-speed live IPL mega auction without race condition failures.
ideas.problem_statement: Qualified teams enter a simulated IPL Mega Auction environment with a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores and participate in real-time digital bidding to build a competitive squad.
ideas.title: CryptoAuction Vault: Secure Squad Registry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cryptographic verification patterns to ensure transaction integrity during fast-paced bidding simulations.

ideas.pitch: A command-line and web toolkit designed to quickly parse, clean, and decode obscured cricket datasets encountered during multi-stage forensic puzzles.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams participate in a multi-stage cyber-investigation challenge involving HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ciphers, cricket datasets, web analysis, and logical problem-solving.
ideas.title: DataSleuth Cricket Dataset Decryptor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speeds up data analysis tasks required to clear the early qualification stages of the escape room challenge.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent bot framework that simulates rival franchise bidding behavior based on historical IPL auction trends to stress-test your ₹80 Crore squad construction strategy.
ideas.problem_statement: Qualified teams enter a simulated IPL Mega Auction environment with a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores and participate in real-time digital bidding to build a competitive squad.
ideas.title: AuctionAgent: Automated Strategy Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rigorous simulation and predictive logic, giving teams an edge in squad valuation prior to the live auction floor.
